messages:
nina: Heads-up: I'm refactoring the SDK examples for streaming/pagination. Main changes: client.stream yields delta events, paginate param renamed to cursor, and we want to show a resume-token pattern for interrupted streams. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4412

paul: nice. For the resume token can we show a tiny example that stores last_cursor/offset and resumes? Some customers build long-running streams that may drop mid-way.

tara: agree. Also ensure Python example uses async iterator and clearly assembles chunks (users keep expecting one final object).

eng-bot: lint check queued for PR 4412. reviewers requested: @paul @tara. examples-sanity queued.

paul: python idea:```py
buf = []
resume_token = None
async for ev in client.stream(req, resume_token=resume_token):
    if ev.type == 'delta':
        buf.append(ev.text)
    if ev.type == 'resume_token':
        resume_token = ev.token  # save progress periodically
result = ''.join(buf)
```
callout: show how to persist token to DB periodically.

tara: TS snippet:```ts
let out = ''
let resume = null
for await (const ev of client.stream(req, { resume_token: resume })) {
  if (ev.type === 'delta') out += ev.text
  if (ev.type === 'resume_token') resume = ev.token
}
// persist resume to storage every N events
```
note: mention for-await-of requires Node >=12+.

support: please include a short retry/backoff example for transient 5xx when streaming. We get a lot of tickets about aborted streams during large batches.

paul: simple backoff pattern (language agnostic) in advanced patterns: exponential jitter, max attempts, and how to reuse resume_token to avoid reprocessing. I'll add concrete py/ts snippets.

eng-bot: examples-sanity passed. docs-build queued.

nina: also renamed page_token -> cursor in all paginate examples. I found one helper in Go that still used page_token; I pushed a fix.

tara: tiny Go patch suggestion:```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
for {
  ev, err := stream.Recv()
  if err == io.EOF { break }
  if err != nil { // classify transient vs fatal; use backoff and resume_token
      return err
  }
  switch ev.Type {
  case "delta": // append
  case "resume_token": // persist
  }
}
```
reminder: import context, time, io.

support: after merge we'll notify support to surface the resume pattern in runbooks. Also request a short blurb in breaking-changes.md about stream iterator + cursor rename.

docs-bot: PR opened: docs#4412  reviewers: @paul @tara. CI: docs-build/examples done.

nina: thanks all. I'll merge after the final review and then post a short changelog note. Ping here if you spot lingering page_token references or if the resume example needs trimming for size. :)
